description: This Java source file defines the KeystoreStep class, which is part of an Android signing wizard in an IDE plugin. It manages keystore selection, password handling, and key extraction for signing Android packages.

classes.name: KeystoreStep
classes.description: A class managing keystore selection, password input, and key extraction for Android package signing within an IDE wizard.

methods.name: makePasswordKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for storing/retrieving passwords based on prefix, keystore path, and optional alias.

methods.name: getPreferredFocusedComponent
methods.description: Determines which UI component should be focused initially based on input fields.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the main UI component panel.

methods.name: getHelpId
methods.description: Provides the help identifier for context-sensitive help.

methods.name: commitForNext
methods.description: Validates input, loads keystore, extracts key, and saves settings/passwords for signing process.

methods.name: loadKeyStore
methods.description: Loads a keystore file with provided password, returning a KeyStore object.

methods.name: loadKeyAndSaveToWizard
methods.description: Retrieves private key and certificate from keystore and stores them in the wizard.

methods.name: getLoadKeyStoreButton
methods.description: Returns the button to load keystore.

methods.name: getKeyStorePathField
methods.description: Returns the text field for keystore path.

methods.name: getCreateKeyStoreButton
methods.description: Returns the button to create a new keystore.

methods.name: getKeyStorePasswordField
methods.description: Returns the password field for keystore password.

methods.name: getKeyAliasField
methods.description: Returns the text field for key alias.

methods.name: getKeyPasswordField
methods.description: Returns the password field for key password.
